exercises.why: Other meanings from the prefix table: вы- — Step out for a short period of time: Секретарь вышел на десять минут. — The secretary left for ten minutes. под- — Подвезти – give someone a lift: Он подвёз меня до центра. — He took me (as far as) downtown. от- — With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. до- — Characterizing the duration of a journey, especially when it is long: Мы наконец доехали до дачи. — We finally reached the dacha. пере- — Changing residence: Я переехала в другой город. — I moved to another city. про- — Movement beyond one's destination (possibly unintentional): Я боюсь, что мы уже прошли магазин. — I'm afraid we already passed the store. на- — Quantified movement: Водитель наездил 50 километров. — The driver covered 50 kilometers. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
